findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_fx_futures_frontier_v1.md lines 150-157: the cost stack enumerates spread, exchange fee, clearing/reg fee, broker commission, min qty, roll cost ('measured from settlement-vs-settlement spreads across the frozen roll rule'), then only 'slippage (stress coverage)' — no frozen slippage estimator (half-spread at the spread authority? fixed tick count from the identity pack? additive or already inside the spread?). The frozen capital tier definition (lines 157-162) consumes 'estimated all-in round-trip cost at the observed tier <= 0.5% of C', so the all-in cost formula — including the slippage component — is an input to a preregistered numeric gate yet is not fully pinned. Everything else in the gate IS frozen (margin from official docs, threshold C/2, tiers $1k/$10k/$300k, ladder 1.5x/2.0x). Residual exposure: an A4 lane that sees cost bytes first can choose a favorable slippage convention and move the per-tier feasibility rows (a standing D2 output and the substrate for the A6 '$1,000 insufficient capital' attack). Bounded because the terminal gate fails only if NO tier is feasible (thresholds scale with C, tiers 2-3 are insensitive), and the ladder partially brackets it — hence MEDIUM, not HIGH.
findings.required_fix: Freeze the slippage estimator in the A4 cost contract at/before the same pre-fetch freeze moment as the roll rule and floors (e.g., slippage := half the measured/documented spread per side from the §4.6 spread authority, or a fixed tick count from the §4.1 identity pack), and state explicitly whether it is additive to the spread component or the spread itself is the slippage base. Plan amendment by the Lead; A7 does not edit.
